notes.title: Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment will release on Steam this year on 23.09.2022
notes.notes:
HELLO. MY NAME IS AR.IA. WELCOME TO SSV KNOSSOS. PLEASE COMPLY WITH THE INSTRUCTIONS.

We’re happy to announce that Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment will release on Steam this year on the 23rd of September!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36173973/2f84de61d310c9f4b58733a9fb21093a78685258.png[/img]

Dive deep into sci-fi psychological thriller, obey the rules, try to solve mysteries behind your ships AI & fulfill the tasks presented by AR.I.A, or don’t … but face the consequences of your insubordination.

 If you want to learn more about Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment, visit our Steam store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1189730/Tales_of_Tomorrow_Experiment/

She awaits you.
